svg.text: Active-duty career intel · hexahedron · military green + cyan data

g.text: Entry sequence
Cube face splits into four panels · blast-door retraction · mechanical precision
Cyan data streams visible inside · camera enters · panels close behind
Audio: 432Hz compresses wide → mono → snaps to metronomic pulse
Environment
3D data lattice · orthogonal grid in military-digital green
Cyan data streams flowing at steady pace along grid edges
Intersection vertices glow as data nodes · amber notification pulses
Coolest palette in portal: structure dominates, warmth serves
Lighting + color
Deep green #27500A structure
Active green #639922 nodes
Cyan #00CED1 data streams
Amber only for NOVA alerts
Audio signature
72 BPM metronomic pulse
Data-processing hum (wideband)
Crisp click tones on interaction
Two-tone alert on policy notif.
Glass-morphic UI overlay
Career dashboard: rank progression timeline · current position highlighted
Certification tracker: active creds → in-progress → recommended next
Policy alert simulation (Corporal Davis scenario):
"New opportunity detected — direct alignment with your goal"
NOVA cross-references MARADMIN → flags gap → recommends action
3D data stream reroutes visibly when alert fires · platform intel manifest
Return to NOVA
Data streams decelerate · grid dims periphery-inward
Blast-door panels reopen · camera reverses · cube seals shut
Audio snaps mono → wide stereo · 432Hz re-expands · release of focus

svg.text: Emotional register: operational awareness · the system knows your name
Visual opposite of Gauntlet: same institutional geometry, but it works FOR you
Narrative anchor: passive storage → proactive career intelligence
